Execution flow: checks if thePublicID and theSystemID are null; if true, checks if theNamespace is not null and exists in VALID_ENTITY_NAMES map; if true, retrieves integer value and calls Character.toChars() to produce a string; otherwise returns null. Potential runtime exceptions: (1) IllegalArgumentException from Character.toChars if integer is invalid Unicode code point; (2) ClassCastException from containsKey if key type mismatch (unlikely given typical typed map). Since the method signature throws XMLStreamException, uncaught runtime exceptions would propagate unexpectedly. Therefore, catching the more likely IllegalArgumentException within this snippet and handling it gracefully (e.g., returning null) is advisable.
